notes.title: MacOS support
notes.content: You may now enjoy the game on your MacOS computer.

notes.title: Co-op Support - 25 April 2023
notes.content:
-Co-op support with two people(mouse and gamepad) on a shared screen.
-After day 3, spawned animals are having more health. With each day after that, it will continue to increase.

notes.title: Gamepad Support - 24 April 2023
notes.content: You can now play the game with a gamepad! Enjoy it.
